readiness.verdict: win rate is below breakeven; more data will not fix that

verdict.headline: Indistinguishable from the market so far.
verdict.detail: Model log loss is +0.000 against the market's on the 114 predictions carrying a logged price (95% CI [-0.008, +0.007]). The interval spans zero, so nothing is proven either way.

totals.note: Over 2.5 goals on fixtures already on the board. Paper only: the model beats a base rate on totals but not the closing line (blend weight 0.00), so these test whether the aligned+floor filter holds on a second market — they are not a proven edge. Unders and both-teams-to-score are excluded: measured at 51% actual against 63% stated, and no skill at all, respectively.

open_lane.note: Every market the model can price, with no conviction floor and no requirement that the model agree with the market. Draws and several calls per fixture are possible here and are not in the main record. Paper only, scored separately.

edge_lab.verdict: No edge. Across 1763 settled legs priced at the same instant, Kalshi and the bookmaker differ by 0.8c on average and never by more than 5c (0% of legs). Only 3 legs ever cleared spread plus fee, so there is no trade here to take. The +14.4% ROI the retrospective test showed was entirely the 8-hour lookahead in that test, not a real mispricing.
edge_lab.note: Kalshi vs DraftKings, priced at the same instant. The value lane opens only if the gap survives spread and fees at 150 settled legs.
